title: Clear done notes
body:
### summary

As a person keeping notes, I want to clear the notes I have finished, so that my list shows only what is left to do.

### completion_goal

1. [api-trace] state: three notes "buy milk", "call Ada", "post letter", the second marked done, then `notes clear`; expected: exit 0, stdout "cleared 1 done note", and `notes list` shows "1 [ ] buy milk" and "2 [ ] post letter"
2. [api-trace] state: two notes, none done, then `notes clear`; expected: exit 0, stdout "nothing to clear", and the notes file unchanged

### measure

Completion Goal criteria observed

### threshold

2 of 2

### scenario

Add three notes, mark the second done, clear, and list; then clear a list with nothing done.

### environment

the CLI built from the checkout, in a fresh directory

### checkpoints

1. `notes clear` removes the done notes and says how many it removed (criteria 1, 2)
